evidence_scope.aggregation: candidate means inside each state, then equal six-state weights; no independent-N66 claim

assessment: No v2 stage improves aggregate template-only rank agreement over B2; this does not establish a generally better hidden-surface predictor.
Pooling alone keeps every full-score choice unchanged while lowering mean rank agreement. It corrects duplicated instance representation, but observed decision benefits are not demonstrated.

Pooling+applicability changes two left-layout choices and trades slightly higher object recovery and fewer actions against lower full-scene recovery. G and S make identical choices in all6states; this is not semantic superiority or a matched-budget policy comparison.
Pooling+geometry+applicability returns all choices to B2 and reduces rank agreement to .61045. Absolute prediction shrinkage alone cannot justify promotion.
No pooled object was excluded by inherited size eligibility in these6states, so observed changes are not explained by that gate.

Sampling-only reproduces all frozen candidate integrals/choices and removes the known history-dependent point-cap confound. A separately declared six-run G/S/no-measured-consumption closed-loop matrix is scientifically justified; preserve earlier C/J controls as reused controls.
recommendation: Keep B2 plus sampling-integrity correction for clean ablation; do not silently adopt geometry, pooling, or applicability as validated improvements. Retain all negative variants and test new method hypotheses prospectively.
